execution_semantics: Dependencies describe evidence flow; R05-R07 are independent branches after shared gates. R08 waits for all required branch receipts in a full-program promotion. R11 is instantiated for each completed/failed physical job and does not require all jobs to finish before safe closeout.

routes.name: Admit source and condition schema
routes.required_output: Evidence records and exact-tree dedup receipt
routes.gate: No held/duplicate source; no copied media

routes.name: Receive identified materials and finished cells
routes.required_output: Lot/cell certificates and accepted variant IDs

routes.name: Request contained preparation and settling
routes.gate: Alternative-viscosity and high-phi states remain separate

routes.name: Qualify synchronized measurement interfaces
routes.required_output: Calibration, clock map and closed-service admission

routes.name: Request low-rate comparison and sparse sweep
routes.gate: Source-reported values remain reference metadata, not executable defaults

routes.name: Request rate-dependence branch
routes.required_output: B05 run bundles with conflict flags
routes.gate: No auto-assignment of coral rate until conflict is resolved

routes.name: Request viscosity control and high-phi extension
routes.gate: Closed qualified service only; missing branches cannot be called completed

routes.name: Measure patterns and correlate pressure events
routes.required_output: B04 morphometry and source-aligned event evidence
routes.gate: Raw time and movie time separate; no digitized plot treated as raw data

routes.name: Review repeats, controls and model comparisons
routes.required_output: Per-branch evidence assessment and unresolved outcomes
routes.gate: No20-point pseudoreplication; no model execution here

routes.name: Tag external context and synthesize conclusion
routes.required_output: B08 context-only references and B09 model-limit statement
routes.gate: Borrowed porous-medium photographs do not become task evidence

routes.name: Close each physical service job safely
routes.required_output: Safe release, contained disposition and cleaning/inspection receipt
routes.gate: Job-level closeout can run immediately after each independent run, before aggregate analysis

routes.name: Archive and review qualification
routes.required_output: Immutable evidence, decisions, holds and final manifest
routes.gate: Review-only packet adds zero completed conversions; future promotion requires separate implementation/audit
